# BLER Travel Brazil

> Travel agency based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, founded in 2004
> (BLER TRAVEL BRAZIL TURISMO LTDA, CNPJ 06.990.616/0001-33).
> Personalized leisure travel, corporate travel management, and back-office
> support for other travel agencies. Partner office in the USA:
> BLER Travel USA, Brookline, Massachusetts. 24/7 support.
> Service in Portuguese, English, Spanish, and Italian.

## What we do

### Corporate travel
- Air tickets, hotel reservations, car rental, executive transfers
- Online booking and management systems, online reports
- Corporate and incentive event organization
- Private aircraft charter
- 24-hour emergency assistance

### Leisure travel
- Tailor-made itineraries, travel packages, cruises, honeymoons
- Ski trips, Disney trips, Israel and religious/spiritual itineraries
- Private transfers and private transport abroad, boat rental
- Travel insurance and 24-hour emergency service

### Back Office Agency Support
- Remote (or on-site) support for travel agencies, hotels and tourism companies
- Air and hotel reservations, package production, itinerary research
- Event and incentive support, VIP client service, training
